source_reading.scope: Abstract/use-case GUI, implementation and full runtime-evaluation sections, conclusion.

adjudication.basis: Although the main contribution is graph-query semantics, the implemented GeL tool lets users inspect and regenerate explanation graphs for selected answer nodes, zoom, search nodes/edges and alter visual detail. Actual interactive RDF exploration is documented; algorithmic timings must not be presented as a user study.
